decision: Activate RESOURCE-ENVELOPE-PILOT-1 for source/reuse, validity and measurement preparation only. Preserve two families, six sizes and two observers. No selected term generation, observer setup/build or scientific launch is authorized before exact committed scientific/execution inputs and independent review.

categories.assessment: The finite binder-model comparison is complete and provides no performance evidence. Resource-envelope preparation can reuse real audited positive-term and supervision assets, while BUILD-MODE-CONFORMANCE remains lower priority because no concrete supported configuration/source site is bound. The selected work is only preparation for an exact 24-cell resource matrix.

The reusable 50-case positive corpus, exporter/importer bridge, real-proof accepted slices, and portable supervisor provide concrete local assets. They do not establish validity for new size points or comparable resource profiles. Three real-proof oversize rows remain unobserved and are excluded as term inputs.
The owner hold on Kiota/Nanoda follow-up remains absent substantive feedback. No resource result or concrete target defect exists yet, so no upstream contact or external action is warranted.

The Lean4export 3.1.0/Lean 4.29.1 source pipeline and exact real-proof importer revisions offer source/reuse leads. The prior positive corpus was accepted under its historical official Lean 4.33.0 and Nanoda 6ae1f0c profiles; this is checking evidence, not a matched resource baseline. Their input paths/settings differ (artifact-path kernel invocation versus Nanoda stdin bytes with four threads and explicit extension/axiom settings), so a new common checking task, completion semantics, configuration, import/startup, and idle-baseline accounting must be bound. Measurements should report serialized bytes, unique DAG nodes, and expanded tree size alongside the fixed size metric.

Source review, independent family-validity reasoning, comparable profile design, metric definitions, baseline/import accounting, RSS sampling uncertainty and nonterminal supervisor-control tests are tractable preparation gates in this item. Selected input generation and observer setup remain gated on frozen reviewed committed manifests.

candidates.rationale: Selected as the highest-value scoped local work after binder closure. Existing audited positive terms and portable supervision make source/validity/measurement preparation concrete. Selection is ACTIVE preparation only; valid families/sizes, common checking profiles, import/startup/baseline accounting, uncertainty and controls remain unpassed gates.
A useful alternative, but supported configurations, input-influenced source sites, and a concrete reproducible build protocol are not yet bound.

blockers.reason: No concrete supported configuration/source site and reproducible fixed build protocol has passed its entry gate.
